# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Inspect station data and calibrate equipment.
3. Review historical emissions data.
4. Collect real-time sensor data.
5. Use remote sensing technology or satellite imagery for larger areas.
6. Confirm compliance with local, regional, and national regulations.
7. Conduct on-site inspections and note any visible emissions or evidence of non-compliance.
8. Gather meteorological data to factor in weather conditions.
9. Perform chemical analysis to identify pollutants and their concentration levels.
10. Document exceedances and analyze trends.
11. List sources contributing to excessive emissions.
12. Detail mitigation measures taken or suggested.
13. Verify calculations for accuracy and completeness.
14. Write a clear and concise report summarizing findings.
15. Include recommendations for reducing emissions and improving the air quality.
16. Present data in graphical form (charts and maps) to aid understanding.
17. Compare results with past reports to identify improvements or deteriorations.
18. Provide references to relevant scientific literature
